name: ATFA Flooring Awards 2027
changelog: 1.7.2 (2026-10-19): Check for updates now works in one click: it clears the cached update list before WordPress checks (it used to clear it straight after, so the update never showed), checks GitHub, and returns to the Plugins page with Update now showing. The update check also reads GitHub past its five-minute cache, and each version's zip has its own address. Includes the 1.7.1 weekend cards.
